name: The Seventy-Two Angels of the Shem ha-Mephorash
dom: the 72-fold Name of God; tutelary angels; the 72 quinances of the zodiac
note: The 72 angels derived from the three verses of Exodus 14:19-21 (each a three-letter combination of the divine Name plus the suffix -el or -iah), each governing a 5-degree quinance of the zodiac; in Rudd's tradition the benevolent counterpart-set to the 72 demons of the Ars Goetia.

name: Agrippa's Planetary Intelligences and Spirits
dom: planetary magic; magic squares (kameas); the seven Intelligence-Spirit pairs
note: The seven paired planetary Intelligences (benevolent directing angels) and Spirits (raw planetary forces) whose names Agrippa derived numerologically from the planetary magic squares in De occulta philosophia II.22.

name: The Seven Olympic Spirits of the Arbatel
note: The seven planetary Olympic Spirits (Aratron, Bethor, Phaleg, Och, Hagith, Ophiel, Phul) who jointly govern the 196 Olympic provinces of heaven, per the Arbatel de magia veterum (1575).

name: Vehuiah
note: The 1st Shem angel (root VHV, Exodus 14:19), ruling the first Aries quinance under Mars; office is willpower, new beginnings, and banishing evil spirits.

name: Jeliel
note: The 2nd Shem angel (root YLY), ruling Aries 5-10° under Mars; office is love, conjugal fidelity, and reconciliation.

name: Sitael
note: The 3rd Shem angel (root SYT), ruling Aries 10-15° under Sol; office is protection against adversity and nobility in great enterprise.

name: Elemiah
note: The 4th Shem angel (root OLM), ruling Aries 15-20° under Sol; office is safe voyages, protection of sailors, and exposing traitors.

name: Mahasiah
note: The 5th Shem angel (root MHSh), ruling Aries 20-25° under Venus; office is living in peace and ease in learning the liberal sciences.

name: Lelahel
note: The 6th Shem angel (root LLH), ruling Aries 25-30° under Venus; office is light, the healing of illness, and renown in arts and science.

name: Achaiah
note: The 7th Shem angel (root AKA), ruling Taurus 0-5° under Mercury; office is patience and the discovery of the secrets of nature.

name: Cahetel
note: The 8th Shem angel (root KHT), ruling Taurus 5-10° under Mercury; office is divine blessing and agricultural abundance.

name: Haziel
note: The 9th Shem angel (root HZY), ruling Taurus 10-15° under Luna; office is divine mercy, forgiveness, and reconciliation.

name: Aladiah
note: The 10th Shem angel (root ALD), ruling Taurus 15-20° under Luna; office is healing, divine grace, and the remission of guilt.

name: Lauviah
note: The 11th Shem angel (root LAV), ruling Taurus 20-25° under Saturn; office is victory, renown, and favour of the great.

name: Hahaiah
note: The 12th Shem angel (root HHO), ruling Taurus 25-30° under Saturn; office is refuge and the revelation of mysteries through dreams.

name: Iezalel
note: The 13th Shem angel (root YZL), ruling Gemini 0-5° under Jupiter; office is fidelity, reconciliation, and skill in learning.

name: Mebahel
note: The 14th Shem angel (root MHB), ruling Gemini 5-10° under Jupiter; office is justice, truth, and protection of the oppressed.

name: Hariel
note: The 15th Shem angel (root HRY), ruling Gemini 10-15° under Mars; office is purity of faith and skill in useful arts and sciences.

name: Hekamiah
note: The 16th Shem angel (root HQM), ruling Gemini 15-20° under Mars; office is protection of rulers and deliverance from treachery.

name: Lauviah (II)
note: The 17th Shem angel (root LAV), ruling Gemini 20-25° under Sol; office is revelation and prophetic inspiration through dreams.

name: Caliel
note: The 18th Shem angel (root KLY), ruling Gemini 25-30° under Sol; office is justice and the exposure of guilt in lawsuits.

name: Leuviah
note: The 19th Shem angel (root LVV), ruling Cancer 0-5° under Venus; office is expansive memory, intelligence, and grace.

name: Pahaliah
note: The 20th Shem angel (root PHL), ruling Cancer 5-10° under Venus; office is piety, chastity, and religious vocation.

name: Nelchael
note: The 21st Shem angel (root NLK), ruling Cancer 10-15° under Mercury; office is the liberal sciences, astronomy, and protection against slander.

name: Yeiayel
note: The 22nd Shem angel (root YYY), ruling Cancer 15-20° under Mercury; office is fame, fortune, and success in commerce and travel.

name: Melahel
note: The 23rd Shem angel (root MHL), ruling Cancer 20-25° under Luna; office is healing through medicinal plants and safe travel.

name: Haheuiah
note: The 24th Shem angel (root HHO), ruling Cancer 25-30° under Luna; office is protection of exiles, fugitives, and refuge-seekers.

name: Nith-Haiah
note: The 25th Shem angel (root NTH), ruling Leo 0-5° under Saturn; office is wisdom, the occult arts, and magic.

name: Haaiah
note: The 26th Shem angel (root HAA), ruling Leo 5-10° under Saturn; office is political wisdom, diplomacy, and truth in judgment.

name: Yerathel
note: The 27th Shem angel (root YRT), ruling Leo 10-15° under Jupiter; office is the spread of light and truth and confounding slanderers.

name: Seheiah
note: The 28th Shem angel (root ShAH), ruling Leo 15-20° under Jupiter; office is long life, health, and protection against accident.

name: Reiyel
note: The 29th Shem angel (root RYY), ruling Leo 20-25° under Mars; office is deliverance from evil influences and divine inspiration.

name: Omael
note: The 30th Shem angel (root AVM), ruling Leo 25-30° under Mars; office is fertility, multiplication, and the natural and medical kingdoms.

name: Lecabel
note: The 31st Shem angel (root LKB), ruling Virgo 0-5° under Sol; office is talent in agriculture and intellectual illumination.

name: Vasariah
note: The 32nd Shem angel (root VShR), ruling Virgo 5-10° under Sol; office is justice tempered by clemency, and eloquence.

name: Yehuiah
note: The 33rd Shem angel (root YHV), ruling Virgo 10-15° under Venus; office is order, protection of rulers, and exposure of conspiracies.

name: Lehahiah
note: The 34th Shem angel (root LHH), ruling Virgo 15-20° under Venus; office is obedience, calming of anger, and good fortune in service.

name: Chavakiah
note: The 35th Shem angel (root KVQ), ruling Virgo 20-25° under Mercury; office is reconciliation and harmony among kin.

name: Menadel
note: The 36th Shem angel (root MNT), ruling Virgo 25-30° under Mercury; office is steadfast work, vocation, and the return of what is lost.

name: Aniel
note: The 37th Shem angel (root ANY), ruling Libra 0-5° under Venus; office is breaking impediments and protection in adversity.

name: Haamiah
note: The 38th Shem angel (root HOM), ruling Libra 5-10° under Mercury; office is religious worship and the acquisition of esoteric truth.

name: Rehael
note: The 39th Shem angel (root RHO), ruling Libra 10-15° under Luna; office is the healing of body and mind and filial love.

name: Ieiazel
note: The 40th Shem angel (root YYZ), ruling Libra 15-20° under Saturn; office is consolation, deliverance from captivity, and inspiration of the arts.

name: Hahahel
note: The 41st Shem angel (root HHH), ruling Libra 20-25° under Jupiter; office is the protection and zeal of missionaries and martyrs.

name: Mikael (Shem angel)
note: The 42nd Shem angel (root MYK), ruling Libra 25-30° under Mars; office is statecraft, diplomacy, and the unmasking of plots (distinct from the archangel Michael).

name: Veuliah
note: The 43rd Shem angel (root VVL), ruling Scorpio 0-5° under Sol; office is prosperity, peace, and the success of enterprises.

name: Yelahiah
note: The 44th Shem angel (root YLH), ruling Scorpio 5-10° under Venus; office is victory in just war and protection of warriors and magistrates.

name: Sehaliah
note: The 45th Shem angel (root SAL), ruling Scorpio 10-15° under Mercury; office is the revival of vital force and the quickening of plants.

name: Ariel (Shem angel)
note: The 46th Shem angel (root ORY), ruling Scorpio 15-20° under Luna; office is the revelation of hidden treasures and secrets of nature.

name: Asaliah
note: The 47th Shem angel (root OShL), ruling Scorpio 20-25° under Saturn; office is the contemplation of divine justice and truth.

name: Mihael (Shem angel)
note: The 48th Shem angel (root MHSh), ruling Scorpio 25-30° under Jupiter; office is conjugal fidelity, friendship, and procreation (distinct from the archangel Michael).

name: Vehuel
note: The 49th Shem angel (root VHV), ruling Sagittarius 0-5° under Mars; office is elevation of the spirit, magnanimity, and literary inspiration.

name: Daniel (Shem angel)
note: The 50th Shem angel (root DNY), ruling Sagittarius 5-10° under Sol; office is eloquence and merciful judgment (distinct from the prophet Daniel).

name: Hahasiah
note: The 51st Shem angel (root HHSh), ruling Sagittarius 10-15° under Venus; office is occult knowledge of natural medicine and alchemy.

name: Imamiah
note: The 52nd Shem angel (root OMM), ruling Sagittarius 15-20° under Mercury; office is the liberation of prisoners and victory over foes.

name: Nanael
note: The 53rd Shem angel (root NNA), ruling Sagittarius 20-25° under Luna; office is the higher sciences, theology, and contemplation.

name: Nithael
note: The 54th Shem angel (root NYT), ruling Sagittarius 25-30° under Saturn; office is the endurance of legitimate authority, grace, and long life.

name: Mebahiah
note: The 55th Shem angel (root MBH), ruling Capricorn 0-5° under Jupiter; office is offspring, the propagation of piety, and clarity of conscience.

name: Poyel
note: The 56th Shem angel (root PVY), ruling Capricorn 5-10° under Mars; office is good fortune, public favour, and fulfilment of wishes.

name: Nemamiah
note: The 57th Shem angel (root NMM), ruling Capricorn 10-15° under Sol; office is the success of commanders and just causes and the deliverance of captives.

name: Yeialel
note: The 58th Shem angel (root YYL), ruling Capricorn 15-20° under Venus; office is healing of the eyes and mind and firmness of judgment.

name: Harahel
note: The 59th Shem angel (root HRH), ruling Capricorn 20-25° under Mercury; office is knowledge, the guardianship of archives, and the prosperity of letters.

name: Mitzrael
note: The 60th Shem angel (root MTzR), ruling Capricorn 25-30° under Luna; office is relief from mental affliction, reconciliation, and just elevation.

name: Umabel
note: The 61st Shem angel (root VMB), ruling Aquarius 0-5° under Saturn; office is astronomy, natural philosophy, and the cultivation of friendship.

name: Iah-Hel
note: The 62nd Shem angel (root YHH), ruling Aquarius 5-10° under Jupiter; office is the contemplative life, philosophical wisdom, and peaceful retreat.

name: Anauel
note: The 63rd Shem angel (root ANV), ruling Aquarius 10-15° under Mars; office is the prosperity of trade, the safety of commerce, and concord.

name: Mehiel
note: The 64th Shem angel (root MHY), ruling Aquarius 15-20° under Sol; office is the protection and inspiration of writers, professors, and orators.

name: Damabiah
note: The 65th Shem angel (root DMB), ruling Aquarius 20-25° under Venus; office is safety at sea, success in maritime enterprise, and the gaining of wisdom.

name: Manakel
note: The 66th Shem angel (root MNQ), ruling Aquarius 25-30° under Mercury; office is reconciliation, the soothing of wrath, and the calming of dreams.

name: Eyael
note: The 67th Shem angel (root AYO), ruling Pisces 0-5° under Luna; office is comfort in hardship, esoteric knowledge, and contemplation of eternity.

name: Habuhiah
note: The 68th Shem angel (root HBV), ruling Pisces 5-10° under Saturn; office is the cure of illness, the fecundity of the soil, and abundant harvests.

name: Rochel
note: The 69th Shem angel (root RAH), ruling Pisces 10-15° under Jupiter; office is the recovery of lost goods, the discovery of thieves, and rightful inheritance.

name: Jabamiah
note: The 70th Shem angel (root YBM), ruling Pisces 15-20° under Mars; office is the regeneration of nature, alchemical transmutation, and spiritual renewal.

name: Haiaiel
note: The 71st Shem angel (root HYY), ruling Pisces 20-25° under Sol; office is bravery, martial triumph, and the deliverance of the just.

name: Mumiah
note: The 72nd and final Shem angel (root MVM), ruling Pisces 25-30° under Venus; office is the completion of works, recovery of health, and the cycle of death and renewal.

name: Agiel
dom: directing intelligence of Saturn; time; limitation; structure; longevity
note: The Intelligence (directing angel) of Saturn, its name drawn from the Saturn magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the Saturn Spirit Zazel.

name: Zazel
dom: raw force of Saturn; restriction; decay; time
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Saturn from the Saturn magic square in Agrippa II.22, the more dangerous counterpart to the Intelligence Agiel.

name: Iophiel
dom: directing intelligence of Jupiter; expansion; fortune; sovereignty; justice
note: The Intelligence of Jupiter (Yophiel), its name drawn from the Jupiter magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the Jupiter Spirit Hismael.

name: Hismael
dom: raw force of Jupiter; expansion; increase
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Jupiter from the Jupiter magic square in Agrippa II.22, counterpart to the Intelligence Iophiel.

name: Graphiel
dom: directing intelligence of Mars; war; force; courage; iron
note: The Intelligence of Mars, its name drawn from the Mars magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the Mars Spirit Bartzabel.

name: Bartzabel
dom: raw force of Mars; war; violence; destruction
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Mars from the Mars magic square in Agrippa II.22, counterpart to the Intelligence Graphiel.

name: Nakhiel
dom: directing intelligence of the Sun; light; kingship; gold; vitality
note: The Intelligence of Sol, its name drawn from the Sun magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the solar Spirit Sorath.

name: Sorath
dom: raw force of the Sun; solar power (number 666)
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Sol from the Sun magic square in Agrippa II.22 (its name summing to 666), counterpart to the Intelligence Nakhiel.

name: Hagiel
dom: directing intelligence of Venus; love; beauty; harmony; copper
note: The Intelligence of Venus, its name drawn from the Venus magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the Venus Spirit Kedemel.

name: Kedemel
dom: raw force of Venus; desire; attraction; pleasure
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Venus from the Venus magic square in Agrippa II.22, counterpart to the Intelligence Hagiel.

name: Tiriel
dom: directing intelligence of Mercury; intellect; communication; commerce; magic
note: The Intelligence of Mercury, its name drawn from the Mercury magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the Mercury Spirit Taphthartharath.

name: Taphthartharath
dom: raw force of Mercury; intellect; trickery; rapid motion
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Mercury from the Mercury magic square in Agrippa II.22, counterpart to the Intelligence Tiriel.

name: Malkah be-Tarshishim ve-ad Ruachoth Schechalim
dom: directing intelligence of the Moon; tides; cycles; dreams; silver
note: The Intelligence (intelligence of intelligences) of Luna, her long name drawn from the Moon magic square in Agrippa II.22; paired with the lunar Spirit Chashmodai.

name: Chashmodai
dom: raw force of the Moon; tides; flux
note: The Spirit (raw force) of Luna from the Moon magic square in Agrippa II.22 (cognate with the demon Asmodeus), counterpart to the lunar Intelligence.

name: Aratron
note: The Olympic Spirit of Saturn governing 49 of the 196 Olympic provinces; offices include alchemy, magic, familiars, invisibility, and longevity.

name: Bethor
dom: aerial spirits; dignities; treasures; medicines; long life
note: The Olympic Spirit of Jupiter governing 42 of the 196 Olympic provinces; offices include commanding aerial spirits, granting dignities and treasures, and prolonging life.

name: Phaleg
note: The Olympic Spirit of Mars governing 35 of the 196 Olympic provinces, called the Lord of War, presiding over matters martial.

name: Och
dom: alchemy and gold; medicine; perfect health; longevity
note: The Olympic Spirit of Sol governing 28 of the 196 Olympic provinces; offices include alchemy/gold, medicine, perfect health, and longevity.

name: Hagith
note: The Olympic Spirit of Venus governing 21 of the 196 Olympic provinces, presiding over love and beauty and bestowing beauty and faithful familiars.

name: Ophiel
dom: the Mercurial arts; all sciences; the philosopher's stone; familiars
note: The Olympic Spirit of Mercury governing 14 of the 196 Olympic provinces; offices include the Mercurial arts, all sciences, and the philosopher's stone.

name: Phul
note: The Olympic Spirit of Luna governing 7 of the 196 Olympic provinces, called the Lord of the Powers of the Moon, presiding over silver, water-spirits, and healing.
